text: Louis starts at the new firm Monday 2 November 2026, 9am sharp. Remind me to text him good luck Sunday night.
jaya bday sat. into pottery atm, mentioned wanting a proper wheel one day but thats a lot lol. maybe a class voucher
Mandla's mum is retiring at the end of March 2027 after 31 years as a nurse. He's planning a surprise do for her.
Had coffee with Bridget this morning. Her son Kai got into the Saturday football academy, she's over the moon.
So Amir got the promotion, he's head of logistics now, starts the new role on the 16th. I should send him a card or something.
Isaac nervous re interview tmrw 10.30, second round. Wish him luck in the morning
oscar's leaving do cancelled, his notice got pushed back so he's staying till Jan
Andre and his wife are off to Lisbon for their anniversary, Thursday till Monday. Their dog Biscuit is going to his brother's.

Dana said her dad's been really struggling since he retired in the summer, doesn't know what to do with himself. He was a bus driver for nearly forty years and now just sits watching quiz shows. Her mum's fed up. Dana's trying to get him into the allotment or volunteering at the food bank on Tuesdays. Check in with her next week about how he's getting on.
Pick up dry cleaning before Friday 5pm
Omar loves vinyl, specifically old Ethiopian jazz. Collects first pressings. Good for future gift stuff.
Kenji's last day at the bank is Friday. Leaving drinks at the Crown from half 5. I'm going straight from work.
Rachel's little girl Isabel turns four on 8 November 2026, party at the soft play that afternoon at 2. Need to get a present, she's obsessed with dinosaurs.
Spoke to Jakub on the phone. First week at the warehouse went fine apparently but the night shifts are killing him. He's tired all the time.
Kwame's sister Eva just had her baby, a boy, born yesterday at 4am. Don't forget to send Kwame congrats and ask about names.
yasmin moving to manchester for the new job, starts 4 jan 2027. sad. need to plan something before she goes
Bao told me his dad's birthday is the 23rd and they're doing a big family meal on the Saturday evening. He wants ideas, dad's into gardening and crosswords.
Note to self: dentist Wednesday at 8.15 am, then I'm working from home the rest of the day.
Kate got the job!!! The design one at the agency. Starts in December. Message her properly tonight
Alana's husband had his knee op yesterday morning, went fine but he's off his feet for six weeks. She's knackered already. I should drop round some food at the weekend.
Kai said he's quitting the restaurant at the end of the month, going back to college in September 2027 to do engineering.

Ming's mum turns 70 next Sunday, they're doing lunch at noon at the dim sum place on Station Road, about twenty of them. Ming says her mum drops hints about a silk scarf every year and nobody ever buys one, so this year Ming's finally doing it. Her brother Bao is flying in from Singapore Saturday morning for it. I said I'd help Ming with the cake.
Farid. Retiring 30 June 2027. He's already counting the days. Wife's planning a cruise for after.
Oisín's first day as deputy head was today. Remind me to ask him how it went on Thursday.

Talked to Olivia at the school gate. Her boy starts at the new nursery tomorrow morning, she's more nervous than he is. She's also just gone back to work three days a week after maternity, at the vet practice, and her husband Kwame is doing nursery pick up on Mondays and Wednesdays. Sounds like a lot. Ask her Friday how the first week went for both of them.

mohammed's brother farid getting married in lahore march 2027, whole family flying out for like 2 wks. mohammed is best man and properly stressed about the speech, his english is fine but he says he goes blank in front of crowds. offered to read a draft. remind me to chase him for it in feb. also farid's fiancee is a doctor, met at uni
Abigail mentioned she's really into bouldering now, goes three times a week. Her birthday's sometime in January.
Katarzyna - Kasia - got made redundant last week. She's putting a brave face on it but I can tell she's worried about money. Call her Sunday afternoon.
Laura's daughter graduated on Saturday, first in the family to go to uni. Laura sent me loads of photos.
Sara starts her new role Monday. She's anxious about the commute more than the job tbh
Louis's girlfriend is called Jaya, works in pharma. Both vegetarian. Have to remember that for the dinner on the 14th at 7.
Must buy Dad's birthday card this week, it's on the 2nd.

Bumped into Isaac at the station. His partner Andre has his PhD viva on Tuesday 10 November 2026 at 2pm, been five years in the making. Andre's barely sleeping and keeps rewriting his slides. Isaac's taking the afternoon off to wait outside with snacks. Their kids are staying at Isaac's mum's that night. Ask Isaac on the Wednesday how it went, and maybe get Andre something to celebrate if it goes well.
Bridget's cat Mango had to have a tooth out on Friday, she was fretting all weekend but Mango's fine now and eating again.
Rachel said her husband is up for promotion, decision comes on the 30th. Fingers crossed for them.
Amir's kid Omar has his first piano recital on Saturday 21 November 2026 at 11am. Amir asked if I want to come, said yes.

Drinks with Dana and Eva after work. Eva handed her notice in today, leaving in four weeks to go freelance. Dana reckons she's mad but I think it's great. Eva's last day should be around 18 December. Remind me to sort a whip-round for her leaving present, she's mentioned wanting a decent espresso machine. Also Dana's birthday is 3 January, she wants nothing apparently, which means she wants something.
Kenji's mum is in hospital again, he flies out to Osaka Thursday night. Text him before he goes.
Mandla is into fantasy football way too much. Also hates mushrooms.
Yasmin's engagement party was meant to be this Saturday but it's been called off. They've split up. She's not really talking about it yet.

ok so voice note. Bao's starting at Google in London, his first day is the 9th, 9am. His mum and dad are coming down that weekend to help him find a flat. He's buzzing. Oh and his birthday's the week after so maybe do something for both.
Tomorrow 7am gym then the big shop. Need to book the car in for MOT too.
Kate's brother Oscar just got his first job as an electrician apprentice. Kate's really proud.
Laura's off on maternity leave from next Friday, due early December. Get a card going round the office before she goes.
Jakub said his granddad Mr Popescu, no wait, his wife's granddad, turns 90 on 12 December 2026. Big family do at their place at lunchtime.
Alana's leaving the council after 22 years. Last day 27 November. She wants zero fuss so no party, just a quiet lunch with her team.
Kwame was offered a promotion but turned it down, he wants to stay hands on. Doesn't want people making a fuss about it.
Ming starts the new job at the hospital on 1 December 2026, morning shift from 7. Her partner Kai is going to drive her the first week. She's dreading the early starts.
Abigail has a new puppy, a spaniel called Rolo. Collected him Sunday.
Rang Mum. Nothing much. She's fine.
Omar's wife Sara had her 12 week scan Tuesday morning, all fine. They're telling family at Christmas.
Remind me to ask Olivia whether her mum's results came back. Appointment was on the 5th.
Isabel Reyes in accounts is retiring in March 2027. Twenty years there. Collection probably in Feb. Loves gin and cooking shows.
Farid's son passed his driving test this morning, first go! Farid's terrified now about him having the car.

Kai's 30th is 14 February 2027 which he hates because Valentine's. He wants to do a weekend in the Lakes with everyone instead, Friday to Sunday, cottage near Keswick. Booking needs to happen by end of November apparently and Alana is organising. He's really into fell running and craft beer at the moment, so either of those for a present. Need to send Alana the deposit by Friday.
Mohammed's dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is Friday at 11 at the mosque on Green Lane. Need to message Mohammed tonight and ask if they need anything.

Lunch w Katarzyna. Her daughter starts uni in Edinburgh next September, so September 2027, and she's already panicking about it. Kat's into wild swimming lately, goes every Sunday morning at 8 even in winter. Mad. Maybe a dryrobe for xmas?
Andre's first day as a paramedic was yesterday. Remind me Saturday to see how the first week went.

Long chat with Jaya on the phone, nearly an hour. Her sister Rachel's moving back from Australia in the new year, January 2027 probably, with her two kids. They'll stay with Jaya's parents for a bit until they find a place. Jaya's excited but her mum is anxious about the space. Jaya also says the job is going well, she got promoted to senior analyst last month. Should send her flowers, I never congratulated her properly.
Weekend plans: repaint the hallway, sort the garage. Nothing else.
